requirements.behavior: Approve, shipment, demo-clock, and demo-service mutations reuse an identity for an identical failed request; changing the payload or succeeding starts a fresh identity. Shipment retry also reuses event_id.

evidence.result: 2 unit tests passed within the 29-test frontend suite

requirements.behavior: HTTP non-2xx, malformed/network failures return data=null with a retryable error; UI mutation handlers stop before changing business state when result.error is set.

evidence.result: 2 tests verify failed HTTP and network responses cannot return success data

requirements.behavior: On reload, CustomerState comes from the analyze API response; cached browser CustomerState no longer overwrites it. Mutations render server-returned state. The demo backend stores state in process memory, so a server restart resets it.

evidence.note: In-process demo state dictionaries; not durable production storage.

requirements.behavior: The UI chooses an event time after the latest service clock, receipt update, and simulation time. Backend rejects earlier event times with INVALID_EVENT_TRANSITION. The example sequence is not-picked-up at 11:35 then picked-up at 11:50.

UI calls resetDemoSession first and only removes local session state/reloads after a successful response. On error, it preserves the local session and displays the error. Backend reset test verifies only the selected demo case and its idempotency records are cleared.
requirements.limitation: The UI reset failure branch has not yet been exercised in a browser end-to-end test.
